prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1290; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent in both kind and force with the shoulder findings documented at presentation. Over the course of ten visits, care followed a typical progression of conservative management, including physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and anti-inflammatory medication. Visit frequency decreased steadily as symptoms improved and strength and motion returned toward baseline. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. No prior injury to the same body region is known from the history obtained. Billed services reflect the treatment rendered, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. Prognosis is favorable with continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up.
